`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W-1:0] winner;
    wire [LEVELS-1:0] encoded;
    genvar i, b;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < W; i = i + 1) begin : g_winner
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : g_low
                if (i == 0) begin : g_edge
                    assign winner[i] = input_padded[i];
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign winner[i] = input_padded[i] & ~(|input_padded[i-1:0]);
                end
            end else begin : g_high
                if (i == W-1) begin : g_edge
                    assign winner[i] = input_padded[i];
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign winner[i] = input_padded[i] & ~(|input_padded[W-1:i+1]);
                end
            end
        end
        for (b = 0; b < LEVELS; b = b + 1) begin : g_encode
            wire [W-1:0] terms;
            for (i = 0; i < W; i = i + 1) begin : g_term
                if ((i >> b) & 1) begin : g_one
                    assign terms[i] = winner[i];
                end else begin : g_zero
                    assign terms[i] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
            assign encoded[b] = (|terms) | (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY && !output_valid);
        end
    endgenerate
    assign output_valid = |input_padded;
    assign output_encoded = encoded;
    // The reference encoder returns an encoded default even on empty input.
    // Retain its shift/truncation behavior, including WIDTH=1.
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] empty_unencoded = 1 << (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY ? W-1 : 0);
    assign output_unencoded = output_valid ? winner[WIDTH-1:0] : empty_unencoded;
endmodule

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);
    reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
    reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
    reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
    reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

    assign grant = grant_reg;
    assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
    assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

    wire request_valid;
    wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] request_mask;
    wire masked_request_valid;
    wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_mask;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request = request & mask_reg;

    priority_encoder #(
        .WIDTH(PORTS),
        .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) priority_encoder_inst (
        .input_unencoded(request),
        .output_valid(request_valid),
        .output_encoded(request_index),
        .output_unencoded(request_mask)
    );

    priority_encoder #(
        .WIDTH(PORTS),
        .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) priority_encoder_masked (
        .input_unencoded(masked_request),
        .output_valid(masked_request_valid),
        .output_encoded(masked_request_index),
        .output_unencoded(masked_request_mask)
    );

    // Form the next thermometer mask directly from the request prefixes.
    // For MSB priority, bit j is set iff some request above j is set.
    // For LSB priority, bit j is set iff some request below j is set.
    wire [PORTS-1:0] request_next_mask;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_next_mask;
    genvar j;
    generate
        for (j = 0; j < PORTS; j = j + 1) begin : g_next_mask
            if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : g_low
                if (j == 0) begin : g_edge
                    assign request_next_mask[j] = 1'b0;
                    assign masked_request_next_mask[j] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign request_next_mask[j] = |request[j-1:0];
                    assign masked_request_next_mask[j] = |masked_request[j-1:0];
                end
            end else begin : g_high
                if (j == PORTS-1) begin : g_edge
                    assign request_next_mask[j] = 1'b0;
                    assign masked_request_next_mask[j] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign request_next_mask[j] = |request[PORTS-1:j+1];
                    assign masked_request_next_mask[j] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:j+1];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    always @* begin
        grant_next = 0;
        grant_valid_next = 0;
        grant_encoded_next = 0;
        mask_next = mask_reg;

        if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (|(grant_reg & request))) begin
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid && !(|(grant_reg & acknowledge))) begin
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (request_valid) begin
            grant_valid_next = 1'b1;
            if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
                if (masked_request_valid) begin
                    grant_next = masked_request_mask;
                    grant_encoded_next = masked_request_index;
                    mask_next = masked_request_next_mask;
                end else begin
                    grant_next = request_mask;
                    grant_encoded_next = request_index;
                    mask_next = request_next_mask;
                end
            end else begin
                grant_next = request_mask;
                grant_encoded_next = request_index;
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            grant_reg <= 0;
            grant_valid_reg <= 0;
            grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
            mask_reg <= 0;
        end else begin
            grant_reg <= grant_next;
            grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
            grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
            mask_reg <= mask_next;
        end
    end
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original datapath computes priority-encoded indices, decodes them back into one-hot grants, and uses index arithmetic plus variable shifts to regenerate the round-robin mask. These serial transformations, followed by arbitration and blocking muxes, are plausible contributors to the supplied approximately 2.08 ns register-to-register path; exact source attribution is unavailable.",
  "rewrite": "Generate priority winners directly using directional request-prefix reductions, and encode the winners with parallel OR reductions. Generate each next-mask bit directly from the appropriate request prefix, separately for masked and unmasked requests. This removes encoded-index arithmetic and barrel shifting from mask feedback and removes index decoding from grant generation. Preserve the existing state names, state encodings, encoder instance names, blocking conditions, and synchronous reset.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to improve setup WNS by shortening mask feedback and one-hot grant generation. A reasonable unverified target is a few tenths of a nanosecond above the 7.79 ns baseline. No synthesis, mapped equivalence, STA, or electrical-check results are available for this candidate, so an improvement is not guaranteed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Prefix reductions and parallel one-hot encoding trade additional combinational connectivity for less serial logic. Removing variable shifts and index decoding should offset much of that cost, but mapped area and buffering depend on synthesis sharing and mapping. Compliance with the 4855.656960 um2 cap and library electrical limits requires evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "No additional state, pipeline stages, initialization dependencies, or input assumptions are introduced. All four named registers retain their meanings and reset synchronously to zero. Blocking, acknowledgement handling, empty-request behavior, mask retention, both priority directions, fixed-priority mode, round-robin mode, and registered output latency are preserved. The helper preserves its empty-input encoded and one-hot defaults. Direct mask-prefix expressions equal the reference shifted masks whenever a valid request is selected; otherwise mask_reg is retained. The implementation does not depend on initially related state values and supports repeated unconstrained resets."
}
